nish: Quick check — I uploaded nova-7b_v2 safetensors bundle to s3://redwood-models/onboard/nova-7b/v2/ (16 shards). Filenames: nova-7b_v2-0000-of-0016.safetensors ... -0015-of-0016.safetensors. Conversion used our safetensors fork with TP=2. Noticed tokenizer weirdness: some training data uses U+3000 (IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE) and tokenizer emits it as a separate token causing KV-cache off-by-one in continuity tests. Can someone run the packaging linter + a staging serve smoke? Pasting the conversion command/log:

`./scripts/convert_weights.sh --src /mnt/ckpt --dst s3://redwood-models/onboard/nova-7b/v2 --dtype fp16 --tp 2 --shards 16 --safetensors` 

logs:
`[INFO] saving shard 0007/0016
[WARN] optimizer state has dtype bfloat16 -> casted to float16
[WARN] tokenizer: unknown character '　' -> fallback token 50265`

katie: Do we have a manifest + checksums for the 16 shards? Also was any quantization applied (fp16 vs bf16 vs fp8) — I need that to validate runtime config.

darren: On staging run, ops-bot just flagged a KV cache ordering issue during continuity test. Posting short error:
`ERROR kv_cache.py: Non-monotonic KV offsets detected on rank=1 (offsets: [0, 128, 128, 256])`

ops-bot: deploy-staging:job-4421: FAIL — Non-monotonic KV cache offsets detected on rank 1. Suggest `kv-rewrite --fix-order` and re-run smoke. See logs: https://staging-logs/redwood/job/4421

devex: packaging-lint outputs:
`- missing manifest.json entry: "tokenizer_overrides"
- shard checksums mismatch: shard 0007 expected crc32=0x3a9bf2ed got 0x3a9bf2ea
- safetensors index not found for shard 0007`

nish: OK — I'll re-run the indexer on shard 0007 and add a tokenizer_overrides entry mapping U+3000->' '. Re-uploading shard 0007 now. Command I'll run:
`python tools/safetensors_indexer.py s3://redwood-models/onboard/nova-7b/v2/0007.safetensors --write-index`

katie: After reupload, can someone smoke test (canary route: TP2 -> fallback TP1) and I'll trigger canary rollout if green. :thumbsup:

darren: I'll run smoke with 32-token continuity prompt and run `python infra/validate_bundle.py --path s3://redwood-models/onboard/nova-7b/v2 --checks kv,shards,manifest` — will post results.

nish: Thanks — pinging @darren @katie when shard reuploaded. ETA ~35m. I'll include the PR with the manifest diff and the safetensors index artifact.

katie: Great. If everything passes, let's schedule a Dedicated onboarding window tomorrow morning to avoid peak traffic.

nish: noted, thanks all.
